static_traits.name: Yang Peitong
static_traits.family_status: Lives with mother,关系亲密,可在遇到困难时与其沟通
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病;without既往类似心理问题与治疗史
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to concretely describe triggering situations and automatic thoughts; fairly good cooperation; somewhat negative tone, accompanied by guilt and self-criticism

basic_info.main_problem: I feel that I am wasting my time on hobbies such as going to concerts and collecting stamps. This view leads me to feel guilt and self-criticism.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of guilt and self-criticism have begun to affect my mood and my enjoyment of important activities.
growth_experiences: 大约六个月前,与一位朋友的对话对其影响显著:朋友批评其爱好'have not生产力',并嘲讽集邮'是老年人才做的事'.此后,每逢周末准备去演唱会或从事集邮活动时,便出现强烈的内疚与自我批评,逐渐难以从爱好中获得快乐.
与Mother关系亲密,同住.遇到困难会与Mother沟通,但在本议题上感到'not yet被理解',因此情绪缓解有限.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on whether I am doing something 'useful/productive'
Enjoyment and leisure equal wasting time

special_situations.event: Preparing to attend a concert on the weekend or actually attending a concert
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一件事not能直接提升not yet来或带来明确产出,那就是have not价值的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 试图劝阻自己减少参与或用理性说服自己not要去,以避免内疚
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am wasting time; I should be doing something more meaningful

special_situations.event: Recalls a friend's criticism of my hobby, or talks about the topic of 'whether it is productive'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' evaluations determine whether my behavior has value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过自我批评来约束自己,Repression兴趣以符合他人标准
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她觉得我not够上进,那我一定是not务正业

special_situations.event: 进行集邮时只注意到其'have not实际产出'的一面
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 活动若have not可见成果或效率,就等同浪费
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries rationally listing pros and cons, but repeatedly focuses on negative evidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些活动一点用都have not

special_situations.event: Recalling past concerts and leisure experiences
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果某次被认为'not够有用',那此类活动一概都是浪费
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Labeling myself as 'wasting time' to force myself to change behavior

core_conflict.wish: Longs, while being recognized by others as 'valuable/productive', to still enjoy personal interests and relaxation at ease
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评价为'not务正业/without用',从而被negate或看not起
defense_goal: 通过自我批评与Repression兴趣来避免被指责
以理性化方式讨论'生产力/价值',以降低被negate时的Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: 需要用'有用/有产出'证明自己的not安自我
object_relations.object_representation: Others who are critical and judgmental (friends/outside world)

object_relations.self_representation: 渴望被理解却感到without助的自我

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others question the 'productivity' of their hobby, or the counseling situation focuses on value/efficiency
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 对方在negate我,如果我享受爱好就会被看not起
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Talks about 'efficiency/output' using objective analysis and data-based language, downplays emotional wording, tone is restrained and organized, avoiding going into subjective feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Strong guilt and self-blame arising when preparing to engage in hobbies near the weekend
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 如果我去享受爱好,就会失败或被认为not思进取
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use苛责,自贬式语句(如'我在浪费时间'),语气严厉,主动放弃或减少爱好行为以缓解Anxiety.

manifestations: 开始质疑爱好的价值,认为去演唱会与集邮'have not意义/have not产出'
Finds it hard to acknowledge the value of pleasure and relaxation themselves, doubting their meaning in life
outcomes: Anhedonia与Reduced interest(对原本喜欢的活动not再享受)

manifestations: 在'Freedom享受'与'对自我负责的生产性'之间感到冲突
After internalizing others' standards, space for self-choice is compressed
outcomes: Suppressing interests through self-reproach, leading to psychological tension and internal friction

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 反复use'我应该做有意义的事'来评判自己
Friends' criticism replays repeatedly in the mind and is treated as the standard for judging oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessive self-criticism, worrying whether hobbies are 'useful'
Clearly cautious when talking about hobbies, tending to use self-blame to restrain behavior

positive_force: 与Mother关系较为亲密,具备基础情感支持的资源
Able to sense that activities such as concerts once brought relaxation and happiness (has memories of positive experiences)
Proactively seeks help and is willing to try counseling and cognitive testing (reality testing)
Having a certain rational analysis ability, able to try to evaluate the pros and cons of activities
negative_force: Internalizes the external 'productivity' standard as the criterion for self-worth evaluation, relying on external evaluation
非黑即白,过度概括与心理过滤等认知偏差Reinforcement内疚
Strong 'should' beliefs leading to self-harshness and avoidance of enjoyment
朋友的负向评价反复trigger内疚与Self-denial,破坏活动乐趣

target_behavior.behavior: Strong guilt and self-criticism appear when engaging in hobbies (concerts, stamp collecting), and she tends to reduce or avoid related activities
antecedent: On weekends or when about to do a hobby
回想起朋友关于'have not生产力'的批评
When talking with others about whether to take up hobbies
target_behavior.core_reason: 将'是否有产出/有用'作为唯一价值标准,受朋友批评trigger并内化为自我评价准则
target_behavior.function: 逃避内疚等not适情绪及避免被他人负面评价
target_behavior.consequence: 对原本带来快乐的活动失去兴趣与乐趣,Low mood,Decreased quality of life
